शुल्क् {c10c} U. (शुल्कय ति-ते)
1 To
gain.
--2 To pay, give.
--3 To create.
--4 To tell, narrate.
--5 To leave,
forsake, abandon.

शुल्कः, --ल्कं [शुल्क्यते अतिसृज्यते
कर्मणि घञ्]
1 A toll, tax, customs,
duty; particularly^1 levied at ferries,
passes, roads &c.; कः सुधीः
संत्यजेद्रांडं शुल्कस्यैवातिसाध्वसात्

.
--2 Gain,
profit.
--3 Money advanced to ratify a
bargain.
--4 Purchase-price (of a
girl); money given to the parents
of a bride; पीडिवो दुंहितृशुल्कसंस्थया

.
--5 A nuptial present.
--6
[]
Marriage settlement or dowry.
--7
Present given by the bride-groom
to his bride.
--Comp.
--खंडनं
defrauding (government) of its due
revenue.
--ग्राहक, --ग्राहिन् m. a
toll-collector.
--दः {1} the giver of a
nuptial present. {2} an affianced suitor.
--शाला --स्थानं a toll-station,
customhouse^2.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar and Jim Funderburk on 20210104. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/20.
[2] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210122. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/48.

शूलः --लं [शूल्-क]
1 A sharp or
pointed weapon, pike, dart, spear,
lance.
--2 The trident of Śiva.
--3
An iron-spit (for roasting meat
upon); शूले संस्कृतं शूल्यम्; cf. अयः शूल.
--4 A stake for impaling criminals;
(बिभ्रत्) स्कंधेन शूलं हृदयेन शोकं

.
--5 Any acute or
sharp pain.
--6 Colic.
--7 Gout,
rheumatism.
--8 Death.
--9 A banner,
an ensign. (शूलाकृ ‘to roast on an
iron-spit’).
--Comp.
--अग्रं the point
of a pike.
--ग्रंथिः f. a kind of Dūrvā
grass.
--घातनं iron-filings.
--घ्न a.
sedative, anodyne.
--द्विष् m. asa
fœtida.
--धन्वन्, --धर, --धारिन्,
--धृक्, --पाणि, --भृत् m. epithets of
Śiva; अधिगतधवलिम्नः
शूलपाणेरभिख्यां Śi. 4. 65;

.
--नाशनं
white sochal salt.
--शत्रुः the
castor-oil plant.
--स्थ a. impaled.
--हंत्री a kind of barley.
--हस्तः a
lancer.
--हृत् m. asa Fœtida.

शुल्व्(ल्ब्) {c10c} U.
(शुल्व-ल्ब-यति-ते)
1 To give, bestow.
--2 To send
away, dismiss.
--3 To measure.
--4
To create, produce.

शुल्व्(ल्ब्) {c10c} U.
(शुल्व-ल्ब-यति-ते)
1 To give, bestow.
--2 To send
away, dismiss.
--3 To measure.
--4
To create, produce.

शुल्वं (ल्बं) [शुला-अच्]
1 A rope,
string.
--2 Copper.
--3 A sacrifical
rite or act.
--4 The proximity of
water, a place near it.
--5 A rule,
law, an institute.
--ल्वा, --ल्वी See
above.
--Comp.
--अरिः sulphur.
--जं brass.

--कः

शूलिन् a. [शूलमस्त्यस्य इनि]
1
Armed with a spear; दुर्जयो लवणः शूली

.
--2 Suffering from colic.

1 A spearman.
--2 A hare.
--3

--2 Deserving
impalement.
--ल्यं Roasted meat.
